hammershus.name: Hammershus
hammershus.slogan: Granite walls still guarding the island's northwest cliffs.
hammershus.line: Hammershus was Scandinavia's largest medieval fortification, raised in the 13th century on a cliff 74 metres above the sea.

christianso.name: Christiansø
christianso.slogan: A fortress island where the cars stay on the mainland.
christianso.line: The islands' external appearance has changed very little in over 300 years.

osterlars.name: Østerlars Round Church
osterlars.slogan: A fortress of a church with a hollow pillar at its heart.
osterlars.line: Built around 1160, its central pillar carries frescoes from about 1350, hidden under limewash until 1882.

bhdueoddefyr.name: Dueodde Lighthouse
bhdueoddefyr.slogan: Climb above sand fine enough to fill an hourglass.
bhdueoddefyr.line: Built in 1962, it is the tallest lighthouse on Bornholm, above dunes of very fine white sand.

bhbornholmsmuseum.name: Bornholms Museum
bhbornholmsmuseum.slogan: Thumbnail-sized gold figures from the island's Iron Age.
bhbornholmsmuseum.line: The Sorte Muld site near Svaneke yielded over 2,000 guldgubber, tiny gold-foil figures from the 6th–7th centuries.
